message.content: Use correlated subqueries for independent aggregates to avoid Cartesian product inflation from multiple LEFT JOINs. Structure: SELECT a.id, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM charges WHERE account_id=a.id AND settled=1) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM refunds WHERE account_id=a.id AND approved=1) AS net FROM accounts WHERE active=1 ORDER BY id. This ensures correct totals when multiple records exist per account. Verify row count matches active accounts if results seem inflated.
